'''Wister Tolann''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] under [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. Thrawn had a low opinion of the man, and composed fitness reports that kept Tolann from rising above the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of Commander. As a result, Tolann spent the final [[Time/Legends|years]] of his [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] career routing waste-management [[Convoy/Legends|convoys]] for [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] and [[Ysanne Isard]] during their reigns as rulers of the Empire. Thrawn's actions caused Tolann's grandson, [[Kester Tolann]], to hate Thrawn's [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]], as well as any [[Non-huMan|nonhuman]] species who, in Wester's [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], dared to compete with Humans.
